desc: convert a Microdesign .mda or .mdp file into a PBM image
r: mdatopbm - convert a Microdesign .mda or .mdp file into a PBM image

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

mdatopbm reads a MicroDesign file as input and Produces a PBM image as output.

If you don't specify mdafile, mdatopbm takes its input from Standard Input.

In addition to the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (most notably -quiet, see
Common Options ), mdatopbm recognizes the following command line options:

-d
Double the height of the output file, to compensate for the aspect ratio used in MicroDesign files.
-i
Invert the colors used.
--
End of options (use this if the filename starts with "-")

The program also accepts option -a for historical reasons, for
the same meaning as the Netpbm common option -plain.
